courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的隧道與地下設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring tunnels and underground works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 深開挖內支撐預壓
related.transfer: 可遷移「自由段伸長的機理與驗證」與「腐蝕截面損失的機理與驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；深開挖內支撐預壓的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Free-length extension mechanism and verification" and "Corrosion area loss mechanism and verification" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Preloading of deep-excavation struts must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦地錨自由伸長、錨碇傳力與試驗可識別性；深開挖內支撐預壓則以內支撐預壓、溫度軸力與分階段卸載為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on anchor free extension, bond transfer and test identifiability; Preloading of deep-excavation struts centres on strut preload, thermal axial force and staged unloading, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「自由段伸長」與「接觸間隙」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到深開挖內支撐預壓，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「第二階偏心的機理與驗證」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Free-length extension” and “Contact gap”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Preloading of deep-excavation struts, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Second-order eccentricity mechanism and verification", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 地錨自由段與錨碇段驗證
history.titleEn: Verification of ground-anchor free and bond lengths
history.text: 地錨試驗的位移同時包含自由段伸長、錨碇段變形與座頭滑移，不能由單一荷重或總位移推定錨固品質。本課把穩定錨碇區、拉力分量、潛變、腐蝕與群體作用逐一拆開，最後以座入損失及完整試驗證據確認地錨的長期功能。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。1999年：美國聯邦公路管理局發布地錨及錨定系統指南，包含試驗與防蝕背景；2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景；2020年：香港擋土牆設計指南提供二〇二〇年版本，其適用範圍不全面涵蓋深開挖。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。
history.textEn: Anchor-test movement combines free-length extension, bond-zone deformation and head slip, so one load or displacement does not establish anchorage quality. The course separates stable anchorage, force components, creep, corrosion and group action, then uses seating losses and complete test evidence to assess long-term anchor function. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 1999: FHWA publishes the ground-anchor guide including testing and corrosion-protection context; 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference; 2020: CEDD provides the 2020 retaining-wall guide, whose scope does not comprehensively cover deep excavation. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.
